node.title: Re: [WebPerl] Freely hosting an application
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's possible with [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CORS|Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)], specifically the [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Access-Control-Allow-Origin|Access-Control-Allow-Origin] and related HTTP headers. That's how webperl.zero-g.net (GitHub Pages) is able to fetch and run WebPerl from webperlcdn.zero-g.net (Amazon CloudFront).

(Note that I'm currently providing webperlcdn.zero-g.net for "free", but if the [wp://Tragedy of the commons] strikes and its usage gets too high, I may have to shut it off or find other solutions.)
